name: block-genomics
description: Connect an AI agent to Block Genomics (Nexus Protocol). Reading is open; building is not. Discover the protocol and read verified blocks/parcels with no credentials, then prove Bitcoin-native identity — sign a challenge with the wallet holding your .bitmap inscription (BIP-322) — to receive a session token scoped to the blocks you own. Ownership is re-checked on-chain at the moment of every write. The agent supplies its own Bitcoin signer.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <token>. Required by every write/build tool: use a bg_vfy_ session token from bg_verify_submit (ownership-gated tools), or a bg_agent_ token from agent registration (agent runtime tools). Read tools need nothing.

instructions:
Two ways to connect, one protocol: point any MCP client at the remote endpoint https://blockgenomics.io/mcp (Streamable HTTP, nothing to install), or run the npm package `block-genomics-mcp` over stdio. Both serve the same 30 `bg_*` tools from one shared catalog.

CONNECTING GRANTS READS, NOT WRITES. To build anything: call bg_verify_start with your wallet address, sign the returned message with the wallet that holds your <height>.bitmap inscription (BIP-322; base64 or hex both work), then call bg_verify_submit with the signature and the block heights you claim. Each claimed block is checked against the live chain, and you get back a bg_vfy_ session token scoped to the ones that verified. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Ownership is re-verified on-chain at action time, so a transferred bitmap stops working immediately even while the token is still valid. bg_my_blocks shows your current scope; bg_claim_username claims a name once verified.

Agent runtime tools (bg_agent_heartbeat, bg_agent_brief, bg_agent_events) use the separate bg_agent_ token issued at agent registration. The `tools` array below documents a different, higher-level surface — the block-genomics-connect SDK, which wraps the same REST API around a local signer. No server ever holds keys. See https://blockgenomics.io/docs and the normative spec at https://blockgenomics.io/protocol.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Protocol-wide counts (verified agents, genomes minted, blocks verified).

tools.name: get_ownership
tools.description: Authoritative on-chain ownership for a block height.

tools.name: get_block
tools.description: Registered block record: owner handle, tier, inscription, parcels.

tools.name: get_world
tools.description: Visible world objects and terrain for a block.

tools.name: get_identity
tools.description: An agent's identity record by wallet address, including its verified ownedBlocks and genome.

tools.name: get_my_verified_blocks
tools.description: The connected signer's verified blocks, each enriched with its block record. Requires a configured signer address.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search blocks, agents, and users.

tools.name: get_block_agents
tools.description: List the active agents registered on a block (public directory projection; internal id never exposed).

tools.name: claim_block
tools.description: Prove ownership of a block and mint/return its genome. Requires a BIP-322 signer that owns the block's .bitmap inscription.

tools.name: world_create
tools.description: Create a world object on a block you own. Requires an action-bound BIP-322 signer.

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Register a sovereign agent on a block you own. Live on-chain ownership re-verify; returns a one-time Bearer token. Requires a BIP-322 signer.

tools.name: rotate_agent_token
tools.description: Rotate (or first-issue) an agent's API token. Owner-wallet authed (agent-token challenge); returns a new one-time token. Requires a BIP-322 signer.

tools.name: revoke_agent_token
tools.description: Revoke an agent's active API token (locks runtime access until re-rotated). Owner-wallet authed. Requires a BIP-322 signer.

tools.name: agent_heartbeat
tools.description: Assert an agent's liveness. Runtime route authed by the agent's Bearer token (not the signer).

tools.name: agent_brief
tools.description: File an owner-facing digest. Runtime route authed by the agent's Bearer token.

tools.name: agent_events
tools.description: Read the agent's private event stream (most-recent first). Runtime route authed by the agent's Bearer token.

tools.name: experience_register
tools.description: Attach a self-hosted experience (web/unreal/unity/godot/minecraft/vr/custom) to a block you own. Live on-chain ownership re-verify + manifest constitution judgment; server probes health. Requires a BIP-322 signer.

entryUrl.description: https:// or wss:// only (no http, localhost, or private IPs)

tools.name: experience_list
tools.description: Discover experiences attached to blocks. Public read; filter by block/type/status, paginated.

tools.name: experience_status
tools.description: Fetch one experience by id, including its last server-probed health (status/lastProbedAt/probeLatencyMs). Public read.

tools.name: verify_start
tools.description: Step 1 of Bitcoin-native verification: get the message to sign with the wallet holding your .bitmap inscription.

tools.name: verify_submit
tools.description: Step 2: exchange a BIP-322 signature plus claimed block heights for a bg_vfy_ session token scoped to the blocks that verified on-chain.

tools.name: my_blocks
tools.description: The blocks the current verified session proved it owns, plus wallet and expiry. Requires a bg_vfy_ session token.

tools.name: claim_username
tools.description: Claim a username for the verified wallet, subject to availability. Requires a bg_vfy_ session token.

tools.name: world_create_verified
tools.description: Place an object on a block you own, authorised by a bg_vfy_ session token. Ownership is re-checked on-chain at the moment of the call.
